title: Tikuvchining shimdagi g'oyasi nimaga aylandi?
hook: 1873 yil 20 mayda shim uchun patent berildi.

scenes.text: 1873 yil 20 mayda AQShda ishchi shimlari uchun bitta patent berildi.
Nevadalik tikuvchi Jeykob Devis shimning tez yirtiladigan joylariga mis parchin qoqib ko'rgan edi.
Kompaniya tarixiga ko'ra, patent olishga uning puli yetmagan. U matoni olgan savdogarga xat yozdi.
Bu savdogar Livay Strauss edi. Patent ikkalasining nomiga berildi.
Parchinli ishchi shimi bugun jinsi deb ataladi. Levi's brendi shu patentdan o'sdi.

description:
Tikuvchi Jeykob Devis shimga mis parchin qoqishni o'ylab topgan va savdogar Livay Strauss bilan birga 1873 yil 20 mayda patent olgan. Shu patentdan bugungi jinsi shim va Levi's brendi o'sib chiqqan.

Sizda ham sherik kerak bo'lgan g'oya bormi? Izohda yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; levistrauss.com and Wikipedia could not be opened from this session). Google Patents US139121 and National Archives Prologue blog 'Forever in Blue Jeans' (US patent 139,121 'Improvement in fastening pocket-openings' granted 20 May 1873 to Jacob W. Davis of Reno, Nevada, jointly with Levi Strauss & Co.); Levi Strauss & Co. 'Evolution of riveted denim' and HISTORY.com (Davis, a Reno tailor, used copper rivets, could not afford the patent fee and wrote to his cloth supplier Levi Strauss); Smithsonian NMAH (Levi's riveted trousers).
